capabilities: Open the vault root in Zed via ribbon button or command palette
Open a selected file or folder in Zed from the file menu
Open the active note in Zed at the cursor's line and column
Configure the absolute path to the zed binary in settings
extras: Manual installation only (build from source) until a PR merges and the plugin is published in the community plugin directory; users must verify the zed binary path in settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand off the current note, folder, or vault to an external editor like Zed.

relations.evidence: Open the current vault, folder, or note in Zed.

summary: Integration that opens the current vault, folder, or note in the Zed code editor, optionally jumping to the cursor's position.
